text: AC-018 is red: a clean temporary Scala 3.4.2 compile of image4s-core fails before project sources because pinned Gale/Ravel and scala3-library 3.7.4 contain TASTy 28.7, while Scala 3.4.2 can read only through 28.4. The internal image foundation remains JVM/JS green at 3.7.4. Closing MIG-110 requires an explicit decision to upgrade ScalaFIM to >=3.7 or to produce and pin a genuinely 3.4-compatible dependency line; adapters alone cannot cross this compiler boundary.
